rule.purpose: annotation-assisted capability diagnosis: can stronger explicit guidance outline the target at all
rule.selection: previous moderate/bad/good reader-agreement diagnostic targets; not held-out validation
rule.crop: identical previous 64 mm crop files, sha256-verified against the conditioning run jobs
rule.guide_reader: first reference file per group; clicks derive ONLY from it
rule.heldout_readers: remaining reference files of the group score every mask
rule.auto1: fixed automatic single positive preserved unchanged (baseline control, no reader information)
rule.positive_sampling: farthest-point sampling in physical mm over guide-mask voxels, seeded at deepest physical-EDT voxel, ties -> smallest linear index
rule.negative_sampling: candidates: physical distance to guide mask in (2,4] mm (near-boundary shell so negatives counter boundary leakage), inside the 64 mm crop, outside EVERY annotated group of the case (all readers, all groups); farthest-point sampling in physical mm, seeded at the minimum-distance candidate, ties -> smallest linear index; larger budgets densify the same ring
rule.prompts: flag1 positives, flag0 negatives (vendor inferer documents 0=negative,1=positive); no class prompts; no mask cleanup
rule.postprocessing: native VistaPostTransformd + invert; no additional cleanup
rule.point_delivery: point-head hook must deliver exactly the input multiset of labels, else abort
